description: A bearded man in a cap and worn work coat kneels in a muddy trench, fitting or cutting a hollowed wooden log pipe, with dark liquid seeping around it. Nearby lie more log pipes, shovels, and a black, tar-like substance. Behind him, a plank-built house has a tall pole with an open flame at its top, and a few figures stand by the house under a dark, bare-tree night. The style is a dark oil painting with no visible text, frame, or wounds.
